name: GetDot
long_description:
Our mission is to help everybody in an organization to take data-driven decisions, by democratizing access to trusted high-quality data and metrics. 

**Chat with your Data Warehouse**

Answer most business questions instantly 24/7. Data teams can focus on deep work, not on answering easy questions about dashboards.

Dot understands your existing data stack: tables, SQL queries, documentation, DBT metrics or LookML are its learning material.

Users can interact via Slack, Teams or our native web app.

➡️  https://getdot.ai/

launches.title: 🦊 Dot - Chat with your data warehouse
launches.tagline: Dot is a chat agent that helps answer business questions on data. Data teams can focus on deep work, not on answering easy questions about dashboards.
launches.body:
### TL;DR Instead of searching through dashboards, Dot gives you answers. It uses language models combined with data in your DWH + documentation to answer questions with SQL and data.

Hi everyone, we are Rick, Sven and Theo and we want enable everybody in your company to be able to take data and fact-based decisions.

### **❌ The Problem**

Static dashboards are not good enough to keep up with changing and detailed business needs. We like a good dashboard as much as everybody. But the reality is 100s or 1000s of dashboards with way too many visualizations that try to fit to every potential business question.

![7 tips and tricks from the dashboard experts](https://www.tableau.com/sites/default/files/2021-11/7%20tricks%20from%20dashboard%20experts.png)

### **✨ Our Solution**

Ask a question, get the answer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69587&key=user_uploads/729456/78de839e-d8f0-44f7-8c99-615e1706f4f8)

🎥➡️ [Watch Our Demo Video ⬅️](https://www.loom.com/share/5852ead90511473ab1cbecd2313ffe4c)

### **🚸 Our Background**

With our first product (<https://www.sled.so/>) we help teams to find, understand and trust their analytics on top of Snowflake. We learned how important it is to have trustworthy data combined with correct logic to enable great analytics.

With Dot, we build on this strong foundation and design the assistant to find and use trustworthy data. We are amazed by the out-of-the box performance of LLMs like ChatGPT and want to bring that to the next level, so everybody in a company gets a personal data analyst.

Data Analyst can then concentrate on building great data models, asking the right questions, designing processes to collect the right data, … (there is so much to do).

### **🙏 Asks**

**If you want to try Dot on your data, reach out to us:** [**hi@sled.so**](mailto:hi@sled.so)

**Or sign up to get early access:** [**https://getdot.ai/**](https://getdot.ai/)
